label: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions
compatibility: OpenAI, most local servers (LM Studio, llama.cpp, Ollama's OpenAI-compatible route, etc.), and most third-party proxies.

label: OpenAI Responses
compatibility: OpenAI's newer Responses API shape. Also implemented by LM Studio, llama.cpp server, Unsloth Studio, and newer vLLM releases -- see web/h3_prompt_optimizer_server_profiles.json for which servers expose it. Use this only against a server that actually implements /v1/responses.

label: Gemini Native
compatibility: Google's native Gemini request/response shape. Requires a Direct API key.
media: Reference media: images, video, and audio.
